description.value: Winston Lodge is an intimate 11-room boutique lodge situated steps from Kicking Horse Mountain Resort and 13 km from Golden, BC, making it a natural base for mountain bikers, hikers, and ski tourers exploring the Canadian Rockies. The property features a dedicated equipment room for bikes, ski storage, and a boot dryer, alongside a barrel sauna and hot tub for post-ride recovery. Guests describe attentive, knowledgeable hosts and a cozy common area with a floor-to-ceiling fireplace — the kind of place a touring cyclist remembers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Winston Lodge website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence across multiple subpages. The /facilities page explicitly mentions a dedicated equipment room with ski storage, bikes, and a boot dryer — confirming secure bike storage. All contact details (phone, address, email) are drawn from the website since OSM carries none; the website also confirms the URL discovered in OSM. Wi-Fi is confirmed via repeated mentions of Starlink internet in room amenity lists.
concerns: OSM record carries no address, phone, or email — all contact details sourced exclusively from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
OSM name is 'Winston Lodge' but the website consistently uses the fuller name 'Winston Lodge & Residences'; the OSM record may be slightly outdated or abbreviated.
Bike storage room described as a dedicated space but no explicit mention of a lock or keycard access — security level of storage is unclear and worth confirming with the property.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Clear WWC fit: boutique mountain lodge adjacent to Kicking Horse Mountain Resort with a dedicated bike/equipment room, drying facilities, hot tub and sauna for recovery, and reliable Starlink Wi-Fi — exactly what a touring or mountain cyclist needs.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Dedicated equipment room described on the /facilities page: 'brand new room with ski storage, bikes for the summer, boot dryer and enough space for your gloves.' Room is separate from guest areas; no mention of locking mechanism but it is a staff-managed, enclosed dedicated storage space

Drying area.detail: Equipment room includes a boot dryer; website states 'Never have wet boots or gloves again.' Directly useful for cycling footwear and gloves

Nearby evening food.detail: Lodge is 'just steps from the renowned Kicking Horse Mountain Resort'; guest review notes 'So close to Kicking Horse for coffee, breakfast and dinner.' Lodge also maintains an F&B recommendations page for restaurants in and around Golden

wow_evidence: dedicated equipment room for bikes, ski storage, and a boot dryer, alongside a barrel sauna and hot tub for post-ride recovery

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Self-described luxury boutique; sauna, hot tub, jetted tub, heated floors; premium mountain resort location
